entries.title: Leviticus 21:1
segments: Priests--defiled for the dead; by touching dead bodies, going where they were, or assisting in burying them, except in the case of near relatives, mentioned in
; and the high-priest might not do it even for them.

entries.title: Leviticus 21:5
segments: Not make baldness; in token of mourning.

entries.title: Leviticus 21:6
segments: Ministers of religion should be distinguished for sobriety, purity, and elevation of character, and for the faithful discharge of their appropriate duties; that to their instructions they may add the weight of their example.

entries.title: Leviticus 21:13
segments: Ministers of religion, even those most distinguished, should in all ordinary cases be examples of purity, propriety, and excellence.

entries.title: Leviticus 21:15
segments: Profane his seed; render his sons unfit for the priesthood, by disregarding these divine directions.

entries.title: Leviticus 21:17
segments: Hath any blemish; the priest, as well as the victims he offered, must be without blemish, to typify the moral perfection which God's service demands; and especially, to shadow forth the perfect priesthood of Christ.

entries.title: Leviticus 21:22
segments: He shall eat the bread of his God; though the blemishes mentioned disqualified them from offering sacrifices, they did not exclude them from performing such duties as were suited to their condition, and receiving a support.

entries.title: Leviticus 21:23
segments: All should avoid engaging in duties for which they are disqualified, and be diligent in the discharge of such as are suited to their condition, and by which they may honor God, and benefit themselves and their fellow-men.
